about_pomodoro: Manage your time with Pomodoro Technique.
Pomodoro Technique is a time management method with a goal of improving focus on your work and reducing distractions.
Developed by Francesco Cirillo in the late 1980s while he was a university student.
about_using_pomodoro_effectively: Manage your time with Pomodoro Technique, effectively.
Pomodoro Technique isn't magic that immediately gives you improved focus or reduced all of distractions.
You must need to be cooperative with, by planning an objective, doing one thing at a time, deserve your break time and repeat until objective is done.
